programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Sign of Four
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Director: Peter Hammond. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke, Jenny Seagrove. A young lady contacts Sherlock Holmes for his help regarding her father who disappeared 10 years ago.

programme.title: Confessions from a Holiday Camp
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.

programme.title: Arizona Dream
programme.desc: 1993. Drama. Director: Emir Kusturica. Stars Johnny Depp, Faye Dunaway, Vincent Gallo. A young New Yorker goes to Arizona for a wedding and becomes intertwined in the lives of two eccentric women.

programme.title: Laboratory
programme.desc: 1980. Sci-Fi. Directed by Bob Emenegger & Allan Sandler and starring Corinne Smith. Five humans are selected by alien scientists for experiments that could see the end of human kind.

programme.title: Rollercoaster - Glimpses
programme.desc: Experience the thrill of an early British rollercoaster first hand in this short film by John Seccombe.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Summer River Fishing/Village Fair. 1981. In the heat of a summer's day Jack goes fishing for roach in a drought-stricken river. He then visits his local village fair where they celebrate the past.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Peril
programme.desc: 1938. Mystery. Directed by James P. Hogan. Stars John Barrymore, John Howard & Louise Campbell. Captain Drummond puts his wedding on hold to hunt down a group of dangerous jewel thieves.

programme.title: Captain Scarlett
programme.desc: 1953. Adventure. Director: Thomas Carr. Stars Richard Greene, Leonora Amar & Manolo Fabregas. Scarlett returns to France to find the Duke of Corlaine seizing property and terrorising resistors.

programme.title: Invasion
programme.desc: 1966. Fantasy. Director: Alan Bridges. Stars Edward Judd, Yoko Tani & Valerie Gearon. An English army unit come up against strange beings from another planet who have landed on earth.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts Entertain. 1963. Stars Irene Ryan, Buddy Ebsen & Jim Backus. Granny is feeling lonely, so the family tries to get her riled up but when the plan fails, they decide to throw a party.

programme.title: They Made Me a Fugitive
programme.desc: 1947. Thriller. Directed by Alberto Cavalcanti. Stars Sally Gray, Trevor Howard & Griffith Jones. An ex-RAF airman joins a gang, but when a robbery goes wrong he is betrayed and framed for murder.

programme.title: Worzel Gummidge
programme.desc: Worzel The Brave. 1980. Stars Jon Pertwee, Michael Ripper & Thorley Walters. Aunt Sally is mistakenly sent with luggage of the new owner of Bloomsbury-Barton Hall and now Worzel must rescue her.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Catwoman Goeth. 1966. Stars Adam West & Burt Ward. Batman is lead to the lair of Catwoman by a clue. Catwoman sets out after the Sandman when she hears of his plans to keep her fortunes.

programme.title: The Man In The Iron Mask
programme.desc: 1977. Adventure. Director: Mike Newell. Stars Richard Chamberlain & Patrick McGoohan. D'Artagnan and the musketeers plot to replace the hated King Louis XIV with his imprisoned twin brother.

programme.title: Look At Life Cinema Steps Out
programme.desc: 1960. A look cinema and its evolution regarding comfort and the different types of films that draw audiences in.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Very Silent Traveller. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Ronan O'Casey & Sam Kydd. Recently released convict Dickie Miller murders Arnold Brockley in an act of revenge.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Special guest Status Quo's Francis Rossi joins Noel and Mike to chat about his love for vintage footage. Plus, we're behind the scenes of 50s Pinewood with Belinda Lee and John Gregson!

programme.title: Look At Life Any Old Iron
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the people who prepare salvaged steel to be re-used, also with a glimpse at the steel foundries which melt it all down again.

programme.title: St. Martin's Lane
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Director: Tim Whelan. Stars Charles Laughton, Vivien Leigh & Rex Harrison. A busker works a poor girl into his act. He leads her to fame even if it means sacrificing his love for her.

programme.title: Memories of Making Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor William Gaunt describes how the Sergeant Cork was produced.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Two Drowned Men. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Sheila Steafel. Thieves found dead in the Thames are identified but Cork suspects they are stand-ins for the real crooks.

programme.title: At the Wheeltappers
programme.desc: Bob Williamson. 1977. At the Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club folk singer Bob Williamson performs 'Candid Camera', 'Five Foot Two', 'Railway Man' and more.

programme.title: Cream Farewell Concert
programme.desc: British super group Cream captured live at the Royal Albert Hall in 1968. Tracks include 'Sunshine of Your Love', 'White Room', 'Politician' and many more.

programme.title: Star Treatment Show
programme.desc: 1979 Southern Televisions version of 'Opportunity Knocks!' This week starring: Koffee 'n Kreme. Young entertainers are given a chance to showcase their talent in their own production. (S1, E03)

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Force on Thunder Mountain
programme.desc: 1978. Sci-Fi. A hiking trip into the mountains brings father and son into contact with the Force.

programme.title: Time Warp
programme.desc: 1981. Sci-Fi. While seeking a cosmic black hole, an astronaut discovers a time warp. Stars Adam West and Gretchen Corbett. Written By Anne Spielberg. Directed by: Robert Emenegger and Allan Sandler.

programme.title: Scarlet Thread
programme.desc: 1951. Crime drama directed by Lewis Gilbert and starring Kathleen Byron, Laurence Harvey and Sydney Tafler. Two high flying crooks take part in a robbery that goes very wrong.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Cat. Cyrus Hampton, a rich old man dying of an incurable disease, arrives in Velarde with a wild tiger. He plans to release the animal in a remote canyon and then hunt him down.

programme.title: Glencannon: The Loving Cup
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Stars Thomas Mitchell & Patrick Allen. A wonderful episode of the rare series about the adventures of Colin Glencannon, the chief engineer of the freighter Inchcliffe Castle.

programme.title: Those People Next Door
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by John Harlow and starring Jack Warner, Charles Victor, Jimmy James & Anthony Newley. A young man's titled parents object to his working-class fiance.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Garden Competition and Dry Fly Fishing. 1980. Jack Hargreaves tours private gardens as he judges them for a competition, then observes the wildlife along the river as he goes dry fly fishing.

programme.title: Tarnished Heroes
programme.desc: 1961. War. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Dermot Walsh & Patrick McAlinney. Major Bell and a ragtag team undertake a dangerous mission to destroy a bridge of strategic importance to the enemy.

programme.title: They Fought the Few
programme.desc: This exclusive film focuses on the unlikely friendship between a British Spitfire ace and one of the Luftwaffe's star pilots. Includes interviews with German pilots who flew over England in 1940.

programme.title: A Home of Your Own
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Jay Lewis Stars Ronnie Barker, Peter Butterworth & Bernard Cribbins. A wordless, satirical look at British builders as they attempt to build a young couple's dream home.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: The Hot Seat. 1960. Stars Jack Warner, Moira Mannion & William Mervyn. George, his daughter, Andy and Grace go on a trip to France, but whilst there they go up against a "hot seat" theft scam.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed at the end of September and the beginning of October.

programme.title: Dancing With Crime
programme.desc: 1947. Crime Drama. Directed by John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Richard Attenborough, Barry K. Barnes, Sheila Sim & Garry Marsh. A Cab driver gets mistaken with a gang. He sets out to expose the group.

programme.title: Doctor in Trouble
programme.desc: 1970. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Leslie Phillips, Harry Secombe & Angela Scoular. A British doctor stows away on a cruise liner in pursuit of the woman he plans to propose to.

programme.title: Look At Life Island at the Crossroads
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the plans to make the Isle Of Man a tourist attraction once more.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1959. The Ghost Train Murder. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, Gorgon Needham and Mary Laura Wood. A Hungarian girl is found murdered; stabbed by knitting needles. (S1, E31)

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Death at Dawn. 1960. Stars Lorne Greene, Robert Middleton & Gregory Walcott. When a powerful gang plagues Virginia City, the Cartwrights are determined to stop them even when they are threatened.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Very Silent Traveller. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Ronan O'Casey & Sam Kydd. Recently released convict Dickie Miller murders Arnold Brockley in an act of revenge.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Fancy some nostalgia? We've got a reel on the life of a 50s milkman and a peek at the late-40s Tinseltown. Plus, an amateur film of a 50s car rally with a pit stop at the Busy Bee!

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. Fit of Conscience. Stars Alfred Burke, Paul Kermack & Margaret Whiting. An enquiry into a bribe of a public servant uncovers deeper issues for Marker.

programme.title: Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy Drama. Directed by Paul Mazursky. Stars Natalie Wood, Elliott Gould, Robert Culp & Dyan Cannon. Two couples find liberation in the Sexual Revolution of the 1960s.

programme.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
programme.desc: 1960. Horror. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Laurence Payne, Adrienne Corri & Dermot Walsh. A man is tortured by the sound of his friend's beating heart after killing him in a jealous rage.

programme.title: Tread Softly Stranger
programme.desc: 1958. Crime Drama. Sizzling Calico (Diana Dors) plans a robbery to cover-up embezzlement and gambling debts of brothers John (George Baker) and Dave (Terence Morgan).

programme.title: Patterns
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Fielder Cook. Stars Van Heflin, Everett Sloane & Ed Begley. Fred Staples finds his ambitions and ethics at odds after being employed by a renowned New York corporation.

programme.title: How To Undress in Public
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Compton Bennett. Stars Fenella Fielding, Reginald Beckwith & Kenneth Connor. A comedic take on the different methods of undressing through the ages.

programme.title: Look At Life Action This Day
programme.desc: 1961. An exciting look at the tough training of the Royal Marine Commandos - some of Britain's finest fighting men.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: Marshal Earp Plays Cupid. 1956. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Jan Shepard, Gordon Jones. A woman catches Wyatt's eye, but she's in love with a man who needs Wyatt's protection from a gang of cattle thieves.

programme.title: The Cisco Kid: South of Rio Grande
programme.desc: 1945. Western. Director Lambert Hillyer. Stars Duncan Renaldo, Martin Garralaga & Armida. Cisco and Pancho infiltrate the operations of Miguel Sanches and free the district from his control.

programme.title: The Turners of Prospect Road
programme.desc: 1947. Comedy. Directed by Maurice J. Wilson. Stars: Wilfrid Lawson, Helena Pickard, Maureen Glynne. An abandoned greyhound puppy is trained to race after being found by a taxi driver.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Model Making and Teaching Fly Fishing Techniques. 1980. A collection of model carts all built by the same man catches Jack Hargreaves attention, he then demonstrates the subtle art of fly casting.

programme.title: A Touch Of The Sun
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. In London's swanky hotel the Royal Connaught, if you need anything ask for Mr. Darling (Frankie Howerd) the ' Mr. Fix-it'. Stars: Ruby Murray, Alfie Bass & Dennis Price.

programme.title: Home to Danger
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Terence Fisher. Stars Alan Wheatley, Guy Rolfe & Stanley Baker. Barbara returns from abroad after her father ended his life. A changed will leaves Barbara in mortal danger.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: A Home of One's Own. 1962. Stars Jack Warner, Michael Arden & Finlay Currie. PC Dixon and the team investigate a robbery, but catching the culprit proves to be a challenge.

programme.title: St. Martin's Lane
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Director: Tim Whelan. Stars Charles Laughton, Vivien Leigh & Rex Harrison. A busker works a poor girl into his act. He leads her to fame even if it means sacrificing his love for her.

programme.title: Look At Life The Dance of Life
programme.desc: 1960. A look at English folk dancing, including the Hobby Horse Dance and the Furry Dance.

programme.title: They Fought the Few

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Dial 999
